answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a raven bet on surviving 43 epochs of grading, and every vine settlement recomputes the tundra schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 43 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
